name: tailscale
title: Tailscale
description: Joins this host to your Tailscale network (or a Headscale one) so you reach it from anywhere without opening ports. Make an auth key at https://login.tailscale.com/admin/settings/keys (or headscale preauthkeys create); optionally advertise the LAN as a subnet route or the host as an exit node.

variables.name: TAILSCALE_AUTHKEY
variables.label: Auth key
variables.description: tskey-auth-… from the admin console, or a Headscale pre-auth key

variables.name: TAILSCALE_HOSTNAME
variables.label: Machine name
variables.description: Name shown in the Tailscale admin console

variables.name: TAILSCALE_ROUTES
variables.label: Subnet routes
variables.description: Advertise your LAN, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24 (approve it in the admin console afterwards); leave empty for none

policy_needs.reason: Tailscale loads the kernel's WireGuard and tun modules when the host has not loaded them
